_about: Source of truth for the daily reel queue (owner rule 2026-10-18: one reel per GST day). Written by studio/app/publish_reel.py; docs/SCHEDULE.md is rendered from it (render-md). Slots: studio/app/slots.json (from docs/BEST_TIMES.md). Times: slot_utc is what the APIs use, local_time is GST.
rule: One reel per GST day: that day the same reel goes to all six platforms, each at its own slot. Two reels never share a day.
order_note: Queue order chosen by the owner 2026-10-18: FDE, STACK, 100 Dreams, MCP.
